item.title: Flights to northern Ethiopia cancelled as fears mount of renewed conflict
item.description: Passenger flights between Ethiopia’s capital, Addis Ababa, and cities in the northern Tigray region have been cancelled amid fears of a return to conflict, with reports of clashes in one area. Ethiopia Airlines, which operates all routes in the country, sent passengers a text message about the cancellations citing “unplanned circumstances”. Neither the airline nor […]

item.title: Seven suspects arrested over highway robbery involving Council of State member
item.description: By Love Wilhelmina Abanonave Police have arrested seven suspects believed to be involved in a highway robbery that targeted a member of the Council of State. The robbery occurred on July 21, 2025, along the Tamale–Buipe highway.
